pivot.if: Thunder, rain, ice, dangerous wind, official closure or a tired dog
pivot.note: Postpone or turn back before the upper stairs. Another exposed outdoor route is not a thunderstorm fallback. Check official park status and NWS again before leaving.

conditions.trail_note: Follow the orange circles and return the same way. Keep Rupert on a six-foot leash and at least one body length from every cliff edge. Do not climb unstable edge rocks. Stop before stairs become uncomfortable.
